Once upon a time I let my Planet Sister live with me while I was pregnant...

TL;DR- I foolishly agreed to let my planet of a sister live with me while I was pregnant. She acted fat, took advantage of me, and has convinced some of my family that I am abusive.

I'm not an easy-going person. Anyone who knows me will tell you that is a huge understatement. I have not always been a shitlady, either. Another understatement. These are the events that made me fed up with my fat slacker sister and anyone else who demonstrates fat, entitled, and/or lazy qualities. My hate for fat does not start here, but it is here where I start recognizing it.

I was in my first trimester when my troubled teenaged cousin got kicked from his house. I've got a soft spot for teenagers who are kicked out by their dads, seeing as I was one, so when he called me up looking for a place I agreed. A week later, Planet Sister calls looking for a place to stay- saying that Drunk Fat Dad is driving her nuts. I told her that Troubled Cousin has the spare room but there's a decent amount of space in the basement if she would really rather stay with me. I'm not a drunk who lets the power go out to feed my vice, so she quickly agrees.

So the set up we had with 4 people was- Planet Sister and Troubled Cousin could either do 1/4 of the housework on a daily and weekly basis (detailed instructions and lists of needed materials were taped to the wall of each room), OR pay 1/4 of the bills (rent, utilities, cable/internet/phone, groceries). There were also some house rules which involved only eating on the ground floor (kitchen, eating area, and living room), keeping their rooms straightened up (especially Planet Sister, since laundry had to be done near her living area and we had to go through her living area to get to the circuit breaker), and picking up after yourself.

Things only went smoothly for about two weeks. The first thing to start was the milk glasses. Planet Sister would drink milk late at night and leave half empty glasses of milk for me to find in the mornings. Well, every night I would wake up after a few hours and spend a few hours vomiting and then go back to sleep for a few more hours, so mornings were not my best. I would only have to go down 2-3 steps in order to smell the warm whole milk sitting in my living room, waiting for me to be revolted by it (I hated the smell of milk before I was pregnant) and to clean it up. I gave Planet Sister a few gentle reminders but it got to where I started stomping over where she was sleeping and yelling at her when she came waddling up the stairs every single morning I found a glass (because she never woke up before I did). She spent hours crying about how I was so mean because I would wake up before her, therefore not allowing her time in the morning to clean up her mess from last night (because she was too lazy to clean up after herself before she went to sleep on my futon).

I became a villain the day I wouldn't take her to the grocery store. It was her only day off that week and I told her that I would take her. I told her that I wasn't going to waste my time, energy, and gas to make my pregnant ass wet to take her to the grocery store so she could get junk food. When she whined about my entitlement (even though she paid nothing for the car, gas, or the insurance on it), I told her that I also was not going to take her to work that day (the city has public transportation). She told people that I denied her food, despite there being a mostly stocked kitchen of food which had to be prepared.

When Troubled Cousin left (because of really long and troubling reasons), Planet Sister wanted the spare room. I told her that we would help her move the stuff up there sometime Wednesday- Saturday (whenever Husband had the day off to move the furniture) as long as it was all straightened up. By Saturday her area was still a disaster, so we started setting the room up. This is when I became the bitch-sister who made her live in the basement the entire time (according to what she's told my family). Never mind the fact that she was too lazy to find the time to straighten up her own possessions (something that is supposed to be done anyway) in a four day time frame in order to have a space with a door.

Being irate at us for using our future nursery, she stopped keeping her area straightened up to the point where I could no longer do laundry because she had her crap so spread out that it stretched to, and covered, the laundry area. I just threw her stuff back to her area and warned her about the circuit breaker. She didn't head my warning. I ended up needing to use the circuit breaker and I couldn't actually access it because I was too far pregnant to go through the obstacle course she had set up. So I cleaned her area. I found broken milk glasses and old Poptarts all in the basement and yet this was such a violation of her privacy (that I cleaned my basement) that she still holds a grudge about it.
